## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-6003. The stock-sync cronjob had a pod that hung during a large file download (stuck at 11.2 MB / 38.4 MB) for over 19 hours. With no timeout configured and `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` enabled, all subsequent scheduled runs were blocked. The fix is to delete the stuck pod, which will unblock the CronJob for normal execution. I also recommended adding an `activeDeadlineSeconds` timeout to prevent future hangs.
